scope: final exact-hash review and mechanical freeze of the integrated presentation layer after every analytic game node closed
migration_authority: none; this bundle does not authorize edits to formal_model_v5.Rmd, formal_model_v6.Rmd, their outputs, or any frozen analytic interface

rejected_release_history.finding: PDF page 57 concatenated the 18.1 and 18.1.1 headings on one baseline without vertical separation

mechanical_close.game_dag_state: all 12 game nodes pass through order 67; this presentation freeze adds no game node and changes no execution order

consumer_contract.authority: this exact review bundle, not a mutation of the candidate release JSON, supplies final consumption authority for the integrated standalone report
consumer_contract.analytic_boundary: the presentation layer may reproduce frozen objects but may not rederive, repair, reinterpret, or select within any analytic correspondence
consumer_contract.review_boundary: both required independent reviewers accepted the same repaired release hash with zero critical, major, or minor findings
consumer_contract.presentation_boundary: the exact 60-page PDF passed a separate full visual rereview after the page-57 repair
consumer_contract.migration_boundary: no result is migrated to the target manuscript; the full-chain release remains a standalone, nonmigrating artifact

conditions: The candidate release JSON intentionally retains its pre-review status and exact bytes; this review bundle records final acceptance.
The rejected a930d511 release and its page-57 defect remain invalidation history and are not consumable.
All direct analytic, governance, presentation, validation, status, and visual components listed above must retain their exact hashes.
The game DAG and proof ledger remain unchanged because the full-chain freeze is a post-DAG presentation layer, not a new equilibrium node.

invalidation.rule: any byte change to the reviewed release, a listed component, an analytic root, a governance artifact, a presentation artifact, a protected target, the master verifier or checks, the candidate status, or the visual audit invalidates this final review and requires two new exact-hash reviews
required_negative_tests: changing the reviewed release hash invalidates final acceptance
changing either required review verdict or finding count invalidates final acceptance
changing any direct component hash invalidates dependency completeness
substituting the rejected a930d511 release invalidates the close
changing the repaired PDF hash or page count invalidates the visual close
reopening a game-DAG node or producing a nonempty Ready frontier invalidates the release
changing a protected artifact invalidates the release
granting manuscript migration authority invalidates this nonmigrating close

artifact_hash_protocol: SHA-256 is computed externally over these exact UTF-8 bytes; the review-bundle digest is reported by the final status and verifier rather than recursively stored in this file
